<div class="question-number">1</div>
### What can international AI summits realistically accomplish?
<div class="question-number second">2</div>

Course syllabus, Day 7, 2026.

# What Can AI Summits Accomplish? {background-color="#041e42"}
## Bletchley Park, November 2023 {.photo-title background-image="../../assets/pe_bletchley_summit.png" background-size="cover" background-position="center"}
::: {.photo-caption}
Twenty-eight countries—including the United States and China—recognized frontier-AI risk as an international problem.
:::
::: {.notes}
Open with the high-water mark of international cooperation on AI. What was unusual was not merely the number of participants: governments with sharply different interests accepted that some frontier-AI risks could not be governed domestically.
[Sources]
UK Government, “The Bletchley Declaration,” 1–2 November 2023; summit image from the instructor's 2026 public-lecture deck.
:::
## Bletchley Created a Process—not a Regulator {.declaration-slide}
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="57%"}
![](../../assets/pe_bletchley_venue.png){fig-alt="UK Government page for the Bletchley Declaration"}
:::
::: {.column width="39%"}
### Shared science
### Common testing methods
### Voluntary firm commitments
<div class="bottom-line">No common thresholds, verification, or enforcement.</div>
:::
::::
::: {.notes}
The declaration established diagnostic consensus and launched a recurring process. It did not create a world AI regulator. The practical model combines summit diplomacy, national AI safety institutes, technical research, and voluntary commitments from frontier developers.
[Sources]
UK Government, “The Bletchley Declaration,” 2023; Meltzer and Triolo, Brookings, 2023.
:::
## The Agenda Broadened With Each Summit {.image-triptych}
<figure>
  <img src="../../assets/pe_bletchley_summit.png" alt="Bletchley AI Safety Summit">
  <figcaption><strong>Bletchley · 2023</strong><br>Frontier safety</figcaption>
</figure>
<figure>
  <img src="../../assets/pe_paris_summit.png" alt="News coverage of the Paris AI Action Summit">
  <figcaption><strong>Paris · 2025</strong><br>Innovation and inclusion</figcaption>
</figure>
<figure>
  <img src="../../assets/day7_new_delhi_summit.png" alt="Official India AI Impact Summit identity">
  <figcaption><strong>New Delhi · 2026</strong><br>Access and development</figcaption>
</figure>
::: {.notes}
The changing names tell the story: Safety Summit, Action Summit, Impact Summit. Broadening the agenda increased relevance to more countries, especially the Global South. It also made sustained attention to frontier governance harder.
[Sources]
UK AI Safety Summit, 2023; Paris AI Action Summit, 2025; Government of India, AI Impact Summit, 2026. Images from the instructor's 2025 and 2026 lecture materials and the official India summit graphic.
:::
